    /// <summary>
    /// Finds a previously instantiated element by its tag string.
    /// For unique tags, returns the single element. For duplicate tags
    /// (e.g. inventory slots), returns the first match — use FindAllByTag() instead.
    /// Also includes auto-tagged unique element names.
    /// Returns null if not found or if Instantiate() hasn't been called.
    /// </summary>
    public static GameObject FindByTag(string tag)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tag)) return null;
        GameObject go;
        if (_tagLookup.TryGetValue(tag, out go)) return go;
        List<GameObject> list;
        if (_tagListLookup.TryGetValue(tag, out list) && list.Count > 0) return list[0];
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns all elements that share the given tag.
    /// Use this for repeated elements like inventory slots, grid cells, etc.
    /// Returns an empty list if the tag is not found or only has a single element.
    /// </summary>
    public static List<GameObject> FindAllByTag(string tag)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tag)) return new List<GameObject>();
        List<GameObject> list;
        if (_tagListLookup.TryGetValue(tag, out list)) return list;
        // Fall back: if it's a unique tag in _tagLookup, wrap in a list
        GameObject go;
        if (_tagLookup.TryGetValue(tag, out go)) return new List<GameObject> { go };
        return new List<GameObject>();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Finds a previously instantiated element by its full hierarchy path.
    /// Path format: "RootName/ChildName/GrandchildName"
    /// Useful when element names aren't unique (multiple "Content", "Label", etc.).
    /// Returns null if not found or if Instantiate() hasn't been called.
    /// </summary>
    public static GameObject FindByPath(string path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) return null;
        GameObject go;
        _pathLookup.TryGetValue(path, out go);
        return go;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the root GameObject created by the last Instantiate() call.
    /// </summary>
    public static GameObject GetRoot()
    {
        return _root;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Destroys the instantiated layout and clears all lookups.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Destroy()
    {
        if (_root != null) UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(_root);
        _root = null;
        _nodes = null;
        _tagLookup.Clear();
        _tagListLookup.Clear();
        _pathLookup.Clear();
    }
